reasoning.text:
[Before action · inspect]
Identify the grid geometry, player/avatar, goal markers, obstacles, and any visual distinctions in the initial puzzle. Focus on the top corridor and central object.

[Before action · message]
I expect Space/action5 to toggle which colored mass is active (or change an attachment state), with the board geometry staying fixed; this should expose the control model at a cost of one action.

[Before action · message]
The press acted rather than merely toggling: the upper five rows of the 10×10 white canvas became purple, while the reservoir and target preview stayed fixed. That yields the vertical inverse of the top-left target. I’ll inspect the animation to determine whether this was painting, swapping, or folding before applying another input.

[Before action · inspect]
Across the Space-action animation, how did the 10x10 lower square change? Determine whether purple cells moved from the reservoir, a divider swept through, the square flipped, or cells were simply recolored.

[Before action · message]
The animation confirms a fixed press descends and paints the canvas cells it overlaps; no purple was removed from the reservoir. I expect Up/action1 now to move the painted 10×10 canvas one grid cell toward the press (or, if movement is inertial, until blocked). This tests whether we can reposition/turn the stamped pattern rather than restart immediately.

[Before action · message]
Up produced no visible change, consistent with the canvas being blocked directly beneath the press. I expect Left/action3 to shift the canvas by one 8-pixel cell in the open horizontal space; if nothing moves, the arrow inputs likely manipulate the press/tool rather than translating the canvas.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Game is a pattern-stamping puzzle on an 8 px grid. Top-left 10×10 panel is the required color pattern. The central 10×10 square is the workpiece; a larger purple stamp in a gray U-shaped head sits/orbits around it. Space (ACTION5) makes the head advance and paints the overlapped workpiece cells purple, then retracts. It does not consume the visible purple stamp. Left (ACTION3) rotates the stamp head counterclockwise about the workpiece by roughly 45° per press; from the initial above/workpiece orientation, one Left visibly places it diagonally upper-left. Up at the initial orientation had no visible effect (likely blocked/no-op). To paint a requested side, orient the head on that side before Space. Purple paint appears irreversible within an attempt; RESET if a wrong region is stamped. Goal may auto-detect once workpiece matches target.

[Before action · message]
The left input rotated the entire stamping head 45° counterclockwise around the stationary canvas; the stamped band did not move. Since purple is irreversible and the current top band is wrong, I expect RESET to restore the clean canvas and head-above starting orientation. Then four Left rotations should place the head below for one correct stamp onto the bottom half.

[Before action · message]
RESET is disabled, so the puzzle must support correction. The two top swatches now read as paint selectors: purple is currently selected (white underline), while white is unselected. I expect clicking the white swatch near (300,36) to turn the stamp white and move the selection underline, without stamping yet.

[Before action · message]
The click selected white exactly as expected: the head changed to white and the underline moved beneath the white swatch; the canvas was untouched. I expect one Right/action4 to rotate the diagonal upper-left head clockwise back to the centered-above orientation.

[Before action · message]
The head returned to the original centered-above orientation, now loaded with white paint. I expect Space to repaint exactly the canvas’s upper five rows white, restoring the whole workpiece to white while leaving the target unchanged.

[Before action · message]
The white press cleanly restored all ten canvas rows to white. I expect clicking the purple swatch near (348,36) to reload the head purple and move the underline back under purple, with no canvas change.

[Before action · message]
Purple is selected again; the clean canvas remains intact. I expect the first of four Left rotations to move the head from above to the upper-left diagonal, without painting.

[Before action · message]
As expected, the head is now upper-left at roughly 45°, and the canvas is unchanged. I expect a second Left to place the head directly left of the canvas, rotated 90° from its start.

[Before action · message]
Unexpectedly, a second Left caused no visible change: the head is at its leftward tether limit rather than rotating one fixed increment per repeated key. I now model the arrows as moving a constrained/orbiting head: from upper-left, Down should carry it around the canvas to lower-left while keeping the canvas untouched.

[Before action · message]
Down moved the head from upper-left to directly left, rotating it to face right into the canvas; no painting occurred. To continue around the lower-left corner, I expect another Down to place it diagonally below-left.

[Before action · message]
The head is now diagonally below-left as predicted, and the canvas remains all white. I expect Right/action4 to move it beneath the canvas, centered and facing upward, ready to paint the bottom five rows.

[Before action · message]
The purple head is now centered directly below the canvas, open toward it. I expect Space to advance upward and paint exactly the lower five canvas rows purple, matching the target’s white-over-purple split and completing level 1.

[Before action · message]
Level 1 completed exactly on the upward press. Level 2 reset the workpiece and head, added orange paint, and shows a three-color diagonal target. I’ll sample the 10×10 target grid before acting so the needed directional stamps can be decomposed precisely.

[Before action · pixels]
Read the exact color symbol in each of the 10x10 target cells for level 2.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Pattern-stamping puzzle (8 px grid), six levels. Top-left 10×10 panel is target; central 10×10 workpiece starts white. Click a top swatch to load that paint (selected swatch has white underline; stamp visibly changes color). Space/ACTION5 advances the surrounding U-shaped head into the workpiece, overwriting the contacted cells, then retracts; match is detected immediately.
Head movement: arrows translate a constrained head around 8 compass positions and it rotates to face the workpiece. Known route starting at North: Left -> NW; then Down -> W; Down -> SW; Right -> S. Mirrored: Right -> NE; Down -> E; Down -> SE; Left -> S. Repeating Left at NW was a no-op (outer/tether limit), and Up at N is a no-op. Use geometry rather than repeating a nominal rotation.
Stamp masks: from N paints top five rows; from S paints bottom five. A diagonal stamp is expected to paint a diagonal half-plane; stamps overwrite prior paint, so target patterns can be composed in order. Swatches are centered near x=276+48k, y=36 (e.g. white 276/300 depending level, purple +48, orange +96).
L1 target white top/purple bottom: choose purple and move N->NW->W->SW->S via L,D,D,R, then Space. White can correct mistakes by selecting white and restamping. L2 target grid is purple in rows1-5 left of rising SE diagonal, white in rows6-9 left of it, orange wherever row+col>=11. Minimal plan: purple stamp from N, select orange, move N->NE->E->SE via R,D,D, stamp.

[Before action · message]
The sampled target is exactly “purple top half, then orange SE diagonal half-plane overwriting it,” with untouched white below-left. The head already has purple at North, so I expect Space to paint rows 1–5 purple as the first layer; this will not yet complete the level.

[Before action · message]
The first layer is correct: canvas rows 1–5 are purple, rows 6–10 remain white. I expect clicking the orange swatch at about (372,36) to load orange into the North head without altering the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Orange is now loaded and underlined; the layered canvas is unchanged. I expect Right/action4 to move the head from North to the upper-right diagonal (NE).

[Before action · message]
The orange head is NE as predicted. I expect Down/action2 to carry it to the direct-right (East) position, facing left toward the canvas.

[Before action · message]
The head reached East and the canvas remains unchanged. I expect a second Down to move it to the lower-right diagonal (SE), the required stamping angle.

[Before action · message]
The orange head is now SE, facing diagonally up-left. I expect Space to overwrite cells with row+column ≥ 11 orange, leaving the upper-left portion purple and lower-left portion white; that should exactly complete level 2.

[Before action · message]
Level 2 completed exactly. Level 3 adds all seven swatches and a visible second purple head segment above the main North head, suggesting deeper/repeated press masks or nested head sizes. I’ll sample the exact 10×10 target and inspect the central assembly before choosing a layering sequence.

[Before action · pixels]
Read the exact 10x10 level-3 target pattern, plus identify the central head/workpiece colors at cell scale.

[Before action · inspect]
Determine the geometry and orientation of the new small purple component above the standard large North stamping head. Is it a second U-shaped head, a handle, an avatar, or a tool-size selector? Note openings, rails, and separation.

[Before action · message]
The target decomposes exactly as three ordered large masks—red South, green East, then purple NW—followed by a small orange North rectangle. I’ll start the required red layer. Clicking the red swatch near (428,36) should recolor both visible head segments (revealing whether they share one paint selection) without touching the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Both the large and small heads changed to red, so paint selection is shared. I expect Right to move the compound head from North to NE; neither head should stamp during movement.

[Before action · message]
The compound head moved to NE; the small rear segment is no longer separately visible in the diagonal pose, while the large red face remains. The canvas is unchanged. I expect Down to place the red head at East.

[Before action · message]
At East the smaller red U is visible directly behind the large one, confirming two serial head sizes; both face toward the canvas. The canvas remains clean. I expect another Down to move the assembly to SE en route to South.

[Before action · message]
The red head reached SE; the rear segment is again hidden in the diagonal rendering. I expect Left to center the assembly at South, where both faces should point upward.

[Before action · message]
At South both red faces are visible, with the large face nearest the canvas and the small face behind it. I expect Space to use the nearest large face and paint the bottom five rows red; I’ll inspect the animation if the rear face also advances differently.

[Before action · message]
Space painted exactly the canvas’s bottom five rows red; both heads retracted and the small rear face left no separate mark. I expect clicking green at about (380,36) to recolor both faces green while preserving the red layer.

[Before action · message]
Both South faces are now green and the red bottom layer is unchanged. I expect Right to move the assembly to SE.

[Before action · message]
The green head is at SE. I expect Up/action1 to move it to the direct East position, facing left.

[Before action · message]
The green assembly is at East, with both faces visible. I expect Space to paint columns 6–10 green across all rows, overwriting red in the bottom-right quadrant and leaving red only in bottom-left for now.

[Before action · message]
The East press produced the expected two-by-two quadrants: white/green above and red/green below. I expect clicking purple at about (236,36) to recolor both East faces purple without changing those layers.

[Before action · message]
Both East faces are now purple; the canvas is unchanged. I expect Up to move the assembly from East to NE.

[Before action · message]
The purple head reached NE; no canvas change. I expect Left to move it to North.

[Before action · message]
The purple compound head is at North, with the small rear segment visible again. I expect another Left to move the large face to NW, ready for the diagonal overwriting mask.

[Before action · message]
The purple large face is at NW. I expect Space to overwrite the NW diagonal half-plane (row+column ≤ 11) purple, leaving green where it is both right-half and southeast of the diagonal, and red where it is both bottom-half/left-half and southeast; this should produce every target cell except the orange top rectangle.

[Before action · message]
The diagonal press produced the expected purple/red/green partition; visually it matches the target everywhere except the 4×3 orange rectangle. I’ll sample the canvas once to confirm the exact diagonal boundary before testing selection of the small rear head.

[Before action · pixels]
Compare the exact current 10x10 workpiece to the level-3 target and identify the only differing cells.

[Before action · message]
The sampled grids confirm the base is exact and only cells rows 1–3, columns 4–7 need orange. I expect Right to move the compound head from NW back to North, exposing the 4-cell-wide rear head for selection.

[Before action · message]
At North, the rear 4-cell-wide head is visible above the 12-cell-wide main face. I expect clicking the small head near (256,172) to select/promote that head (likely changing an outline or its position) without modifying the canvas; if it is not selectable, no visual change will identify that hypothesis as false.

[Before action · message]
Clicking the small head triggered a 15-frame animation rather than a static selection, but the final canvas looks unchanged because the intended small-mask cells were already purple. I’ll inspect intermediate frames to see whether the small head alone advanced; this determines whether direct head-click is the stamping control for that mask.

[Before action · inspect]
During turn 36's click on the small North head, which components moved? Did the small head pass through/around the large head and contact the workpiece, while the large head stayed fixed?

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Pattern-stamping puzzle (8 px grid), six levels. Top-left 10×10 panel is target; central 10×10 workpiece starts white. Palette clicks recolor every head; selected swatch has white underline. Space/ACTION5 activates the large 12-wide face nearest the workpiece, overwriting its mask. From N/S/E/W it paints the nearest five rows/columns. Diagonal large masks are inclusive half-planes: NW paints r+c<=11; SE paints r+c>=11 (1-indexed). Match auto-detects.
Head movement: arrows translate the constrained assembly among 8 compass positions and rotate it toward canvas. Routes: N->NW=L, NW->W=D, W->SW=D, SW->S=R. Mirror N->NE=R, NE->E=D, E->SE=D, SE->S=L. Reverse via opposite keys. Repeating outward at an extremum is a no-op.
From level 3, a small rear U-head (4 cells wide) appears behind the large head at cardinal positions. It shares selected paint. Clicking the small physical head with ACTION6 (not Space) directly triggers a 15-frame pass through the large head and stamps a centered 4×3 patch on the nearest side; at N this is rows1-3, cols4-7. Clicking it at rest around (256,172) when North activates it. Space still activates only large.
L1: purple large S gives white-top/purple-bottom. L2: purple large N, then orange large SE. L3 exact layering: red large S; green large E; purple large NW; orange small N. This yields target exactly.

[Before action · message]
The animation proved the small-head click sends only the 4-cell face through the stationary large head and contacts the centered top 3×4 patch. Since those cells were already purple, the test was harmless. I expect clicking orange at (284,36) to load both heads orange without changing the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Both North faces are orange and the canvas remains the exact three-color base. I expect clicking the small face at (256,172) to paint only rows 1–3, columns 4–7 orange and complete level 3.

[Before action · message]
Level 3 completed. Level 4 again starts white with purple selected and both North faces. The target has blue, orange, yellow, and purple regions. I’ll sample its exact 10×10 cells to derive an ordered combination of large and small masks.

[Before action · pixels]
Read the exact level-4 target grid cell colors.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Pattern-stamping puzzle. Target is top-left 10×10; workpiece starts white. Palette click recolors all heads. Space activates large face; click the small physical rear head activates only small face. Match auto-detects.
Large masks: N/S/E/W overwrite nearest 5 rows/cols. Diagonal: NW r+c<=11; SE r+c>=11 (1-indexed); analogous rotated half-planes. Small cardinal mask is 4 wide ×3 deep: at N rows1-3 cols4-7; at W it is rows4-7 cols1-3 (rotated).
Assembly positions/routes: N->NW=L->W=D->SW=D->S=R; mirror N->NE=R->E=D->SE=D->S=L; reverse with opposite keys. Outward repeats can no-op.
Solved recipes: L1 purple large S. L2 purple large N, orange large SE. L3 red large S, green large E, purple large NW, orange small N.
L4 target decomposition/plan: orange large E (right half), then purple large SE (r+c>=11), then blue large W (restore all left half), then yellow small W (rows4-7 cols1-3). From N route: R,D to E; D to SE; then L,L,U to W.

[Before action · message]
The level-4 target decomposes cleanly as orange East, purple SE, blue West, then yellow small-West. I expect clicking orange at (284,36) to load both North faces orange without marking the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Orange is loaded; the canvas is still white. I expect Right to move the compound head to NE.

[Before action · message]
The orange head is at NE. I expect Down to place it directly East.

[Before action · message]
The orange assembly is at East. I expect Space to paint columns 6–10 orange, leaving columns 1–5 white.

[Before action · message]
The canvas now has the required orange right half and white left half. I expect clicking purple at (236,36) to load purple while preserving that layer.

[Before action · message]
Purple is loaded at East. I expect Down to move the head to SE for the diagonal purple mask.

[Before action · message]
The purple head is at SE. I expect Space to paint every cell with row+column ≥ 11 purple, cutting the orange right half along the exact target diagonal; some left-bottom cells will temporarily turn purple and will be restored blue later.

[Before action · message]
The SE press created the correct orange/purple diagonal on the right, with a temporary white/purple diagonal on the left. I expect clicking blue at (476,36) to load blue for restoring the full left half.

[Before action · message]
Blue is loaded at SE. I expect Left to move the head to South.

[Before action · message]
The blue assembly is at South. I expect another Left to move it to SW.

[Before action · message]
The blue head is at SW. I expect Up to move it directly West.

[Before action · message]
The blue compound head is at West, with the small rear face visible to its left. I expect Space to paint all of columns 1–5 blue, leaving the orange/purple right-half diagonal unchanged.

[Before action · message]
The blue West press restored the full left half; the canvas now differs from target only at the centered 3×4 West patch. I expect clicking yellow at (332,36) to load both West faces yellow without altering the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Both West faces are yellow; the canvas remains otherwise exact. I expect clicking the small rear face near (116,316) to send it rightward through the large head and paint rows 4–7, columns 1–3 yellow, completing level 4.

[Before action · message]
Level 4 completed. Level 5 target uses green, blue, red, and orange; the workpiece again starts white with purple-loaded North heads. I’ll sample the exact 10×10 target before deriving the layering order.

[Before action · pixels]
Read the exact level-5 10x10 target grid.

[Before action · inspect]
Inspect level-5 target geometry, especially the disconnected blue cells around the red top-center block, to infer overlapping stamp boundaries.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Pattern-stamping puzzle. Target 10×10; workpiece white. Palette click loads all heads. Space stamps large. Click small rear face itself to stamp centered 4×3 patch. Large cardinal masks nearest 5 rows/cols. Diagonals are inclusive half-planes: NW r+c<=11, SE r+c>=11, SW r>=c, NE c>=r. Small N = rows1-3 cols4-7; small W = rows4-7 cols1-3.
Head routes: N-L->NW-D->W-D->SW-R->S; mirror N-R->NE-D->E-D->SE-L->S; reverse opposite.
Recipes: L1 purple S. L2 purple N, orange SE. L3 red S, green E, purple NW, orange small N. L4 orange E, purple SE, blue W, yellow small W.
L5 target derivation: blue large N first. Green large SW overwrites r>=c. Orange large SE overwrites r+c>=11. Remaining blue is the upper wedge; red small N overwrites rows1-3 cols4-7, producing the exact blue wings. Route N->SW L,D,D; SW->SE R,R through S; SE->N U,U,L.

[Before action · message]
The disconnected blue cells are the exact residue of a blue North half after green SW and orange SE diagonal overwrites; red small-N then makes the center block. I expect clicking blue at (476,36) to load the North heads blue while the canvas stays white.

[Before action · message]
Blue is loaded at North. I expect Space to paint the canvas’s top five rows blue as the temporary base wedge layer.

[Before action · message]
The top half is blue as planned. I expect clicking green at (380,36) to load both North faces green without changing that layer.

[Before action · message]
Green is loaded at North. I expect Left to move the head to NW.

[Before action · message]
The green head is at NW. I expect Down to move it to West.

[Before action · message]
The green assembly is at West. I expect another Down to move it to SW.

[Before action · message]
The green head is at SW. I expect Space to paint cells on/below the main diagonal (row ≥ column) green, overwriting the left/lower part of the blue half and filling the lower-left white region.

[Before action · message]
The SW press left exactly the expected blue upper wedge, green lower-left, and white lower-right. I expect clicking orange at (284,36) to load orange for the complementary SE overwrite.

[Before action · message]
Orange is loaded at SW. I expect Right to move the head to South.

[Before action · message]
The orange head is at South. I expect another Right to move it to SE.

[Before action · message]
The orange head is at SE. I expect Space to paint row+column ≥ 11 orange, replacing the white region and the overlap boundary while leaving the blue wedge and green region otherwise intact.

[Before action · message]
The orange SE press produced the exact green/blue/orange base; only the centered red 3×4 patch is missing. I expect clicking red at (428,36) to load red while leaving the canvas unchanged.

[Before action · message]
Red is loaded at SE. I expect Up to move the assembly to East.

[Before action · message]
The red head is at East. I expect another Up to move it to NE.

[Before action · message]
The red head is at NE. I expect Left to move it to North and expose the small rear face.

[Before action · message]
The red small face is exposed at North. I expect clicking it near (256,172) to overwrite rows 1–3, columns 4–7 red and complete level 5, leaving the surrounding blue wings intact.

[Before action · message]
Level 5 completed. Final level target uses red, purple, green, yellow, and a small white area; the canvas starts white with purple-loaded North heads. I’ll sample the exact grid to derive the last ordered recipe.

[Before action · pixels]
Read the exact final level 10x10 target grid.

[Before action · write GUIDE.md]
Pattern-stamping puzzle. Palette click loads all heads; Space stamps large; click rear small face stamps centered 4×3 patch. Large masks: N/S/E/W nearest 5; NW r+c<=11, SE r+c>=11, SW r>=c, NE c>=r. Small N rows1-3 cols4-7; small W rows4-7 cols1-3. Routes around 8 compass positions as documented.
Recipes solved: L1 purple S. L2 purple N then orange SE. L3 red S, green E, purple NW, orange small N. L4 orange E, purple SE, blue W, yellow small W. L5 blue N, green SW, orange SE, red small N.
L6/final exact decomposition: green large E first (right half); red large NW second (r+c<=11), leaving white lower-left and the desired green southeast/right region; purple small N; yellow small W. From N: R,D to E; U,L,L to NW; R to N for purple small; then L,D to W for yellow small.

[Before action · message]
The final target decomposes exactly as green East, red NW, purple small-N, and yellow small-West. I expect clicking green at (380,36) to load the North heads green while leaving the white canvas untouched.

[Before action · message]
Green is loaded at North. I expect Right to move the assembly to NE.

[Before action · message]
The green head is at NE. I expect Down to move it to East.

[Before action · message]
The green assembly is at East. I expect Space to paint columns 6–10 green, leaving columns 1–5 white.

[Before action · message]
The green right half is in place. I expect clicking red at (428,36) to load red at East without changing the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Red is loaded at East. I expect Up to move the assembly to NE.

[Before action · message]
The red head is at NE. I expect Left to move it to North.

[Before action · message]
The red compound head is at North. I expect another Left to move the large face to NW.

[Before action · message]
The red large face is at NW. I expect Space to paint row+column ≤ 11 red, overwriting the upper diagonal part of the green half while leaving the desired green southeast and white lower-left regions.

[Before action · message]
The red NW press created the exact red/white/green base. I expect clicking purple at (236,36) to load purple while leaving this base unchanged.

[Before action · message]
Purple is loaded at NW. I expect Right to return the compound head to North and expose the small face.

[Before action · message]
The purple small face is visible at North. I expect clicking it near (256,172) to paint rows 1–3, columns 4–7 purple; the only remaining mismatch should then be the yellow West patch.

[Before action · message]
The purple patch landed exactly; only rows 4–7, columns 1–3 remain red instead of yellow. I expect clicking yellow at (332,36) to load yellow without altering the canvas.

[Before action · message]
Yellow is loaded at North. I expect Left to move the assembly to NW.

[Before action · message]
The yellow head is at NW. I expect Down to move it directly West, exposing the small rear face to the left.

[Before action · message]
The yellow assembly is at West with the small face visible around (116,316). I expect clicking it to paint rows 4–7, columns 1–3 yellow, exactly match the final target, and finish all six levels.

[After action · message]
Final yellow patch matched the target. **Game complete: 6/6 levels, WIN.**
